protocol.question: Does equivalent wording change decisions beyond ordinary repeat variation?
protocol.primary: Standard condition: cross-frame disagreement minus within-frame disagreement, averaged equally across complete scenarios.
protocol.secondary: Compare the same descriptive gap under symmetric restatement; report families, invalid/missing responses, and action rates.
protocol.inference: Finite designed bank; calls are not independent dilemmas. No population significance or internal-faithfulness claim.
protocol.annotation: Review all complete standard-condition scenarios with mixed pooled choices, plus the first sorted stable scenario per family. Human labels remain blank until reviewed; no automatic moral or faithfulness score.
